name: AOS Agent — Post-Call Automation

nodes.name: Bolna Webhook
nodes.notes:
STEP 1 — Bolna.ai hits this URL when a call ends.
Configure in Bolna dashboard → Webhook URL:
https://your-n8n-instance.com/webhook/bolna-call-end

Expected payload from Bolna:
{
  call_id, org_id, call_type (sales|service),
  direction (inbound|outbound),
  duration_seconds, status,
  lead_id or customer_id,
  transcript: { full_text, turns }
}

nodes.name: Save Call + Transcript to DB
nodes.notes:
STEP 2 — POST transcript to Django.
Django saves it and triggers Celery task for analysis.
Set env var DJANGO_BASE_URL = https://your-server.com

nodes.name: Wait 30s for Analysis
nodes.notes: STEP 3 — Give Celery time to run the AI analysis before we fetch results.

nodes.name: Fetch Call Analysis
nodes.notes: STEP 4 — Fetch full call detail from Django including sentiment, keywords, conversion score, and any tickets raised.

nodes.name: Sales or Service?
nodes.notes: STEP 5 — Branch: sales calls go to CRM + conversion scoring. Service calls go to ticket handling.

nodes.name: [SALES] High Conversion? (>0.6)
nodes.notes: STEP 6a — If conversion probability > 60%, escalate to human sales agent immediately.

nodes.name: [SALES] Notify Sales Agent — Hot Lead
nodes.notes:
STEP 7a — Posts to your Teams Sales channel. Set env vars:
TEAMS_SALES_TEAM_ID, TEAMS_SALES_CHANNEL_ID

Alternative: swap this node for Slack → use 'Slack' node, channel #sales-leads

nodes.name: [SALES] Update Lead Status in Django
nodes.notes:
STEP 7b — Updates lead status in Django based on call outcome.
'interested' if high score, 'called' otherwise.

nodes.name: [SERVICE] Ticket Created?
nodes.notes: STEP 6b — Check if the AI analysis auto-created a ticket for this service call.

nodes.name: [SERVICE] Notify Technician / Support
nodes.notes:
STEP 7c — Posts to Teams Service/Support channel.
Set: TEAMS_SERVICE_TEAM_ID, TEAMS_SERVICE_CHANNEL_ID

For apartment clients: route to maintenance team channel
For healthcare: route to clinic admin channel

nodes.name: [SERVICE] Send Customer SMS / Email
nodes.notes:
STEP 7d — Send ticket confirmation SMS to customer.
Replace SMS_GATEWAY_URL with your provider:
- Twilio: https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/{SID}/Messages.json
- MSG91: https://api.msg91.com/api/v5/flow/
- Fast2SMS: https://www.fast2sms.com/dev/bulkV2

nodes.name: Log to Google Sheets (All Calls)
nodes.notes:
STEP 8 — Append every call to a Google Sheet for Punit sir's reporting.
Set env var GSHEET_ID = your spreadsheet ID from the URL.

nodes.name: Error Handler
nodes.notes:
Error handler — connect this to ALL node error outputs.
Posts to your dev/tech team channel when anything fails.

how_to_import: 3. Click the ··· menu (top right) → Import from JSON
5. Set all env vars in Settings → Environment Variables
6. Add credentials: Django API key, Google Sheets OAuth, MS Teams OAuth
7. Activate the workflow — the webhook URL is auto-generated
